lessons.trigger_condition: After card measurement, the user could see expected grades, generation/set and market references, but had to infer a reasonable transaction amount manually across multiple marketplaces.
lessons.prevention_rule: For an exactly identified card and edition, compute per-source representative prices first, use independent completed-sale/API evidence for a conservative median recommendation, show the reference range and every contributing source amount, and fail closed on name-only identity, mixed variants, asking-only evidence, one-source evidence or severe cross-source divergence.
validation_required: grading cockpit keeps expected grade, PSA probability and generation/set context
trade recommendation requires exact card-number identity and confirmed edition
asking-only evidence never creates a recommended transaction amount
one marketplace cannot dominate by returning more listings because source representatives are collapsed first
severely divergent independent-source prices hold instead of fabricating a midpoint
source name, representative KRW amount, evidence class and observation count remain visible
no grading calibration, non-core grading activation or market-direction logic changes
lessons.safety_boundary: The recommendation is a reference from verified public evidence, not a guaranteed execution price or profit claim; missing grades and prices are never invented.
